title: React Native Intern (Students and Freshers)
description:
We're hiring a
**React Native Developer**
Intern to build the mobile experience behind Fitsoul, an AI-powered SaaS platform for fitness and healthcare. You'll ship real features to real users, not sandbox projects.

**Details:**
**1-month unpaid internship**
, remote (Thiruvananthapuram). Based on performance, selected interns may receive a
**2-month paid extension**
. Exceptional performers may be considered for full-time roles subject to requirements.

**Stack We Build In:**
React Native, Fastify, TypeScript, Python (FastAPI), Supabase, AWS

**Looking for:**
Genuine hands-on React Native experience, someone who's actually built a mobile app. Open to working across the broader stack. Clear, proactive communicator.

**Apply here, no direct emails or DMs**
